arabic text: ZAINAB KE SAATH FIZZA\nZAINAB KE SAATH FIZZA HAR GHAM UTHA RAHI HAI
english translation text: ALONG WITH BIBI ZAINAB, BIBI FIZZA IS ENDURING ALL HARDSHIPS/SUFFERING

arabic text: EK DUSRE SE DONO AANSO CHUPA RAHIN HAI
english translation text: BOTH OF THEM ARE HIDING THEIR TEARS FROM EACH OTHER

arabic text: BAZAR E SHAM ME HE MAJMA SHARABIO KA
english translation text: THE MARKET OF DAMASCUS IS FULL OF DRUNKARDS

arabic text: ZAINAB K AGEY AGEY CHAL KAR JANAB E FIZA
english translation text: JANABE FIZZA IS WALKING IN FRONT OF BIBI ZAINAB…

arabic text: ZEHRA KI BETIO KA PARDA BANA RAHI HEN
english translation text: ACTING LIKE A VEIL FOR THE DAUGHTERS OF BIBI ZAHRA

arabic text: HAR EK QADAM PE DURRE JORO JAFA MUSALSAL
english translation text: EVERY STEP OF THE WAY, THE PRISONERS ARE WELCOMED BY CONTINUOUS WHIPPING

arabic text: KUFE KI SHAAM KI HAIN GALIYAN MISAAL E MAQTAL
english translation text: KUFA AND SHAAM ARE NO LESS THAN A BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: SHAHZADIYON KI SAANSE RUK RUK KE AARAHI HAI
english translation text: THE PRINCESSES (OF AHLUL BAYT) ARE UNABLE TO EVEN BREATHE PROPERLY

arabic text: BAZAAR KI JAFA ME DARBAR KE SITAM ME
english translation text: FROM HUMILIATION IN THE MARKETS TO TORTURE IN THE PALACE…

arabic text: FIZZA SHAREEK E GHAM HAI BINTE ALI KE GHAM ME
english translation text: BIBI FIZZA IS ALONGSIDE THE DAUGHTER OF ALI (A.S), SHARING HER SORROWS

arabic text: PAYGHAM E KARBALA KO HAR DAM BACHA RAHI HAI
english translation text: SHE IS SAVING THE MESSAGE OF KERBALA AT EACH AND EVERY OPPORTUNITY

arabic text: SARWAR KA SAATH JAISE ABBAS NE NIBHAYA
english translation text: THE WAY ABBAS (A.S) SUPPORTED IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S)…

arabic text: ZAINAB KA SAATH DEKE FIZZA HAR EK LAMHA
english translation text: BIBI FIZZA STOOD BY BIBI ZAINAB AT EVERY STEP

arabic text: HAQ E WAFA NIBHANA SAB KO SIKHA RAHIN HAI
english translation text: IN THIS WAY, SHE TAUGHT US THE EMBODIMENT OF LOYALTY AND ALLEGIANCE

arabic text: KARBOBALA KA MAIDAN WOH SHAM HO YA KUFA
english translation text: WHETHER IT WAS THE PLAINS OF KERBALA, SHAAM OR KUFA…

arabic text: ZAINAB KO SHAHE DEEN KO CHORA KAHIN NA TANHA
english translation text: (BIBI FIZZA) NEVER LEFT BIBI ZAINAB (A.S) NOR IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) ALONE

arabic text: DEEN E KHUDA KI KHATIR BAZU BANDHA RAHIN HAI
english translation text: FOR THE SAKE OF GOD’S RELIGION, SHE WAS EVEN READY TO HAVE HER HANDS TIED

arabic text: HUM RAAHH HAI SAFAR ME SHABIR KI YATIMA
english translation text: AMONGST THE CARAVAN, THERE IS SHABBIR’S ORPHAN DAUGHTER

arabic text: FIZZA KO GHAM YEHI HAI BEHAAL HAI SAKINA
english translation text: THE ONLY GRIEF BIBI FIZZA HAS IS THAT BIBI SAKINA IS NOT AT EASE

arabic text: BACHI KI SISKIAN BHI DIL KO DUKHA RAHEIN HAI
english translation text: THE CRIES OF THE LITTLE GIRL ARE ACHING HER HEART CONTINUOUSLY

arabic text: SALMAN AZMI YEH HAR CHASHME AAM ME HAI
english translation text: ‘SALMAN AZMI’ (POET’S NAME) - NOW IT IS CLEARLY VISIBLE TO THE PUBLIC

arabic text: ZAINAB KE SAATH INKI TURBAT BHI SHAAM ME HAI
english translation text: HER RESTING PLACE IS ALONG WITH BIBI ZAINAB IN SHAAM

arabic text: ZAINAB KA SAATH AB TAK FIZZA NIBHA RAHEIN HAI
english translation text: TILL THIS DAY, BIBI FIZZA IS LOYAL AND FAITHFUL TO BIBI ZAINAB
